name: Update earthquake data

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "*/5 * * * *"

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  update-earthquake:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Fetch latest JMA earthquake data
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          curl --fail --retry 4 --retry-delay 3 --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 45 \
            -A "GEONET-monitor/1.0" \
            "https://api.p2pquake.net/v2/jma/quake?codes=551&limit=20" \
            -o /tmp/quake.json

          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path

          src = Path("/tmp/quake.json")
          data = json.loads(src.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

          if not isinstance(data, list) or not data:
              raise SystemExit("No earthquake data returned")

          q = data[0]
          eq = q.get("earthquake", {})
          h = eq.get("hypocenter", {})

          def f(v):
              try:
                  return float(v)
              except Exception:
                  return None

          points = q.get("points") or []
          scales = []
          for p in points:
              try:
                  scales.append(float(p.get("scale")))
              except Exception:
                  pass

          scale_names = {
              10: "1", 20: "2", 30: "3", 40: "4",
              45: "5弱", 50: "5強",
              55: "6弱", 60: "6強", 70: "7"
          }

          max_intensity = ""
          if scales:
              s = max(scales)
              max_intensity = scale_names.get(int(s), str(s))

          latest = {
              "source": "JMA",
              "received_time": q.get("time"),
              "earthquake_time": eq.get("time"),
              "place": h.get("name", ""),
              "lat": f(h.get("latitude")),
              "lon": f(h.get("longitude")),
              "depth_km": f(h.get("depth")),
              "magnitude": f(h.get("magnitude")),
              "max_intensity": max_intensity
          }

          if latest["lat"] is None or latest["lon"] is None:
              raise SystemExit("Latest earthquake has no hypocenter coordinates")

          Path("latest_earthquake.json").write_text(
              json.dumps(latest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
              encoding="utf-8"
          )

          print(json.dumps(latest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
          PY

      - name: Commit and push changed earthquake data
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          git add latest_earthquake.json

          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No change in latest earthquake data."
            exit 0
          fi

          git commit -m "Update latest earthquake data"
          git push
